trap.label: of ausente
trap.wrong: We ran out time in the meeting.
trap.right: We ran out of time in the meeting.
trap.why: Em português “ficar sem tempo” não tem preposição entre os dois elementos; o aluno omite of. Em inglês, run out of é uma unidade com o objeto.

fix.wrong: We ran out coffee in the talks.
fix.right: We ran out of coffee in the talks.

fix.wrong: She runs a meeting of the supplier talks, yesterday.
fix.right: She ran a meeting of the supplier talks yesterday.

fix.wrong: They ran in trouble with the supplier.
fix.right: They ran into trouble with the supplier.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com run out of: “We have no time left.”
rewrite.answer: We have run out of time.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com run a: “She leads the procurement team.”
Reescreva com ran into: “We unexpectedly met a problem.”
